The closest “for” material was procedural discipline inside the military and a limited biometric refusal clause, both of which fall far short of independent oversight.","evidence":[{"title":"Decree amending military statutes","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-03-01","url":"https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50378/print","summary":"Putin required commanders to prevent crimes and incidents, immediately report weapon loss, notify the military prosecutor / investigators / FSB, and personally take part in investigations of serious catastrophes and violent crimes inside units.
